scenes.say: Where is every driver on track right now? The live 3D map shows you.
Rotate and zoom the map, switch to a top view and turn on corner labels.
Under the map there's a table with gaps, tyre compounds and tyre age. Tap a driver and the car lights up on the map.
Missed a race? Replays go back to twenty twenty-three, on the same data you'd have seen live.
The championship table also updates during the race, and there are odds for the win and the podium.
Open LapRadar for the next race.

title: How to watch a race on the LapRadar 3D map
